title: First tranche disbursed to 4,000 farming households on schedule
summary: The first tranche of the facility has been disbursed to 4,000 farming households, a ministry official said, with cooperatives reporting the money arrived on schedule. Local partners will run the training component.

title: Blended finance facility eyes expansion to two more countries
summary: Officials describe the guarantee structure as replicable, pointing to an independent review of the results framework. No disbursement figures were given.

title: Ministry scraps green guarantee after donor pressure
summary: The ministry has scrapped the blended finance guarantee, weeks after the first tranche of concessional money was disbursed, according to two people briefed on the decision.

title: Cotton prices fall for a third week
summary: Traders point to slow demand from mills and a stronger currency.

title: Governments must lead on climate finance, minister tells summit
summary: The minister said the national strategy would be government-led, with national staff running delivery and a training programme to build an in-house team.
